# A fill with zero is left to the compiler, which turns it into memclr: on a 4 KiB
# byte slice memclr takes 16 ns, a vector loop 27 ns. All spellings of zero count.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ZeroInt(dst []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0
	}
}

func ZeroFloat(dst []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0.0
	}
}

func ZeroHex(dst []uint16) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0x0
	}
}

func ZeroRune(dst []byte) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = '\x00'
	}
}

func ZeroExp(dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0e0
	}
}
